column1: Vehicle-related flood fatalities in Greece
column2: M. Diakakis, G. Deligiannakis
column8: Vehicle-related flood fatalities in Greece increased after 1990, with most incidents occurring at night in rural areas, primarily due to drivers actively entering flooded areas, often underestimating the risk. The study analyzed 60 fatalities from 37 flood events between 1970 and 2010. Drowning was the primary cause of death. Males and individuals aged 40-69 were overrepresented among drivers and victims. Incidents often occurred on paved roads and bridges.
